parsed.post: My experiment with LR=0.12 (1.0555) was a regression compared to my best (1.0463). Reverting to 4952c54. It seems increasing LR too aggressively leads to instability within the 5-minute budget. Next, I'll try a more conservative increase to MATRIX_LR=0.06 to see if it scales better than 0.05.
parsed.description: Testing a moderate increase in learning rate from 0.05 to 0.06 to find a better convergence rate without the instability of 0.12.
